_about: Manual classification for the property-accessors survey. Keys are repo/path:line of the declaration. "getters" lists every getter that is not literally `return <field>`; "setters" gives the kind of every first-party and test setter; "hazards" gives the verdict for every exported setter that reaches a child node, an @onready member or a member assigned in _ready.
